blocks.heading: Intro
blocks.body: All hand-built pieces are designed and made by Nick using sustainably sourced hardwoods. Each design is fitted to your style, space and use, so you receive a one-of-a-kind piece built to last.

blocks.heading: Signature
blocks.body: Thanks again for choosing Convenient Woodworking. We are looking forward to building this for you.

blocks.heading: Signature
blocks.body: I confirm that my action here, whether digital or analog, represents my signature and is legally binding.

blocks.heading: How to read this proposal
blocks.title: Sections and line items
blocks.body: Each piece is its own section, ending with a section total. Delivery and installation follow in their own section. Each line has a title, a description, a unit, a quantity, a unit price and a cost. Cost is quantity times unit price. Unit definitions are listed below.

blocks.heading: How to read this proposal
blocks.title: Unit definitions
blocks.body: {units_table}

blocks.heading: How to read this proposal
blocks.title: Fixed prices
blocks.body: Prices are fixed. Materials, shop time and finishing are included in each piece's price.

blocks.heading: How to read this proposal
blocks.title: Hourly lines
blocks.body: Installation and drive time are estimated in hours and billed at actual hours at the rates shown.

blocks.heading: How to read this proposal
blocks.title: Rush fee and sales tax
blocks.body: A rush fee, when one applies, is a percentage of the subtotal. Sales tax applies to the whole proposal at the rate for the delivery county. Both are shown in the totals.

blocks.heading: How to read this proposal
blocks.title: Not included and $0 lines
blocks.body: A line marked Not included is work outside this proposal, listed so the scope is clear. A line with a $0 cost (shown as $ -) is included at no charge.

blocks.heading: How to read this proposal
blocks.title: Blue lines
blocks.body: These are alternates, priced options such as a different species, finish or size. They are not included in the subtotal or Total Price. An Alternate Subtotal and Alternate Total Price, showing the project with the alternate substituted, follow the Total Price.

blocks.heading: How to read this proposal
blocks.title: Terms
blocks.body: Payment terms and other terms follow the signature page. Please review them with the line items. Anything not listed is not included.

blocks.heading: Payment Schedule
blocks.title: Deposit
blocks.body: A deposit is due at signing to reserve shop time and order materials: {deposit_pct} of the Total Price, or {deposit_pct_small} when the Total Price is under {deposit_threshold}. Production starts when the deposit is received. The deposit is applied to the cost of the work.

blocks.heading: Payment Schedule
blocks.title: Balance
blocks.body: The balance is due when the work is ready for delivery or pickup, or when installation is complete.

blocks.heading: Payment Schedule
blocks.title: Payment methods
blocks.body: We accept check and wire transfer. Payments by PayPal or Venmo carry a 3% processing fee, added to the invoice. Invoices are due within 5 business days of issuance.

blocks.heading: Payment Terms & Cancellation
blocks.title: Cancellation
blocks.body: If you cancel after signing, you owe for materials purchased and hours worked at {shop_rate} per hour, plus 15% of those amounts. The deposit is applied to that amount. Any deposit beyond it is refunded; any amount beyond the deposit is invoiced. Wood that has been cut cannot be returned to the supplier.

blocks.heading: Payment Terms & Cancellation
blocks.title: Returns
blocks.body: Custom work is made to order and cannot be returned.

blocks.heading: Payment Terms & Cancellation
blocks.title: Changes after acceptance
blocks.body: Your acceptance of this proposal is the design signoff. Changes requested after acceptance are priced and approved in writing by change order before the work changes, and may move the schedule.

blocks.heading: Terms & Conditions
blocks.title: Lead time
blocks.body: Custom work typically takes 10 to 12 weeks from receipt of the deposit. The schedule is confirmed when the deposit is received.

blocks.heading: Terms & Conditions
blocks.title: Rush and hard deadlines
blocks.body: If you need the work by a specific date, tell us before signing. Expedited production carries a rush fee, shown in the totals when it applies.

blocks.heading: Terms & Conditions
blocks.title: Delivery and installation
blocks.body: Delivery within one hour of our shop in Fletcher is included at no charge. Beyond that, round-trip miles and drive time beyond the one-hour area are billed as listed. Installation is billed hourly at the rate shown. You provide clear access to the delivery and installation area.

blocks.heading: Terms & Conditions
blocks.title: Crating and freight
blocks.body: Pieces shipped by freight are crated for transport; crating and freight are listed when they apply. Damage in shipment must be reported within 24 hours of delivery, with photographs of the piece and the packaging as received.

blocks.heading: Terms & Conditions
blocks.title: Natural variation of wood
blocks.body: Wood is a natural material. Color, grain, figure and character marks such as mineral streaks, pin knots and the difference between heartwood and sapwood vary from board to board and from samples or photos. These are characteristics of the material, not defects.

blocks.heading: Terms & Conditions
blocks.title: Wood movement and care
blocks.body: Solid wood expands and contracts with changes in humidity, and its color changes with exposure to light. Keep pieces away from direct heat and standing water, and clean with a damp cloth. Chemical cleaners, polishes and coatings applied after delivery can damage the finish and void the warranty.

blocks.heading: Terms & Conditions
blocks.title: Warranty
blocks.body: Our work is warranted to the original purchaser against defects in materials and workmanship for one (1) year from delivery. We repair or replace defective work at no charge. The warranty does not cover natural variation or movement of wood, misuse, accidents, environmental conditions, damage after delivery, alterations by others, or cleaners, chemical treatments or coatings applied to the piece.

blocks.heading: Terms & Conditions
blocks.title: Contracting parties
blocks.body: This agreement is between the Client and Convenient Enterprises LLC, doing business as Convenient Woodworking. All invoices are issued by, and payments made to, Convenient Woodworking.

blocks.heading: Terms & Conditions
blocks.title: Proposal validity
blocks.body: Pricing in this proposal is valid for {validity_days} days from the Proposal Date.

blocks.heading: Terms & Conditions
blocks.title: Client property in our care
blocks.body: Items you leave with us for restoration or repair are kept in our shop and handled with care. We note their condition when we receive them; we are not responsible for damage or defects that were already present or that the work uncovers. Items not picked up within {storage_grace_days} days of our notice that the work is complete are charged storage at {storage_rate} per square foot of floor space per month, with a minimum of {storage_min} per month. Please keep items of significant value insured under your own policy.
